analyst: Manual analysis using Claude Opus 5.5 for verification and code analysis

servers.server_cost: Free server: "Documentation search is free. No token, account or configuration is required." Motion+ (separate endpoint /plus): one-time purchase per developer ("Pay once", "Yours forever"; amount did not load); annual Pro add-on (AI agent Ultramotion)
servers.pricing: Free documentation search; one-time Motion+ license; annual Pro add-on
servers.restrictions: Paid features need Motion+ sign-in; the performance audit only profiles a "running local site"
servers.governance_logic: 1) Monetisation via tool responses: "the rest is tiered, and the tools say so when you reach them" - the free tool tells the agent about paid features. 2) Two servers by access level (free / plus). 3) The performance evaluation methodology (MotionScore) is defined and changed on the server side and delivered at call time. 4) Behaviour rules in skills.
servers.structure_note: Two servers (free / plus) plus skills and a reviewer agent (plugins/motion/agents/motion-reviewer.md) in a separate repository
servers.actions_comment: Free server: 1 (search-motion-docs). Plus: not published (at least 4 groups: audit, example source code, springs, transition editor)
servers.tokens: Cannot be determined (minimal with one tool)
servers.agent_cannot: Without Motion+: generate springs, run the audit, get example and Motion UI source code; the agent cannot buy a license.
servers.gov_promises: Data processing and telemetry not described; the Motion+ audit analyses the user's project source code - what is sent to the server is not described.
servers.user_promises: "Hand-written advice by the creator of Motion"; "Nothing gets pasted into chat" (about sign-in)
servers.promises_vs_logic: Cannot be compared (closed code, no governance statements)
servers.notes: Not the Motion calendar (usemotion.com). Endpoints: free https://mcp.motion.dev (CSV: /mcp), paid https://mcp.motion.dev/plus. Direct requests from our environment were blocked by the network policy (the CSV records HTTP 200 without sign-in).

Tools.desc: Free server: 1 tool search-motion-docs (examples, compatibility etc. also via it: "there is no separate tool"). Paid server: MotionScore audit, source code of 450-510+ examples and Motion UI, spring generation, saved transitions (names not published).
Tools.post: Not documented; the audit methodology is "served live to your agent from the Motion+ MCP server"

Authorization.desc: Free server: none. Plus: sign-in from the editor ("Ask Cursor to sign you in and it hands you a link. Nothing gets pasted into chat")

actions.desc: Search the Motion documentation (also used for examples and compatibility questions); tells the agent about paid features when it reaches them

observations.text: Freemium inside MCP: the free server itself tells the agent about paid features - a sales channel through the agent.
A minimal server (1 tool); the main logic is in skills on the client side.
A methodology loaded from the server can change without updating the client.
